postSelectionEligibilityConfirmation.eligibilityAssessment: Genuine 3-document base+amendment-and-restatement+second-amendment-and-restatement chain between the same two parties, same facility, novel domain (crypto-asset-collateralized lending from Coinbase Credit, Inc.) never previously touched by this codebase in any phase. Meets S4.B (multi-document, at the low end of the 3-6 range) and is expected to meet S4.C (meaningful complexity - a $200M secured credit facility of this kind virtually always carries negative covenants, defined terms, baskets, reporting obligations, and cross-references; confirmed during source acquisition, not assumed).
